cloud.title: Cloud automations
cloud.intro: Schedule device syncs or agent sessions from your account. Missed runs are skipped.
cloud.ownership: Cloud schedules belong to this account. Local automations stay separate and work after sign-out.
cloud.emptyHint: Choose a connected computer, then schedule a projection sync or an agent session.
cloud.syncHint: Ask the computer for its session state and update the remote read projections. This does not upload unrelated local sessions or files.
cloud.agentHint: Create a session in an authorized project. Execution and approvals remain on the selected computer.
cloud.epochHint: This computer’s connection changed or was revoked. Choose its current connection explicitly before saving.
cloud.noDevices: Connect a computer in Desktop Settings, then refresh this page.
cloud.invalid: Check the name, schedule, computer and session fields.
cloud.deleteHint: Delete this schedule and its run history? Agent sessions already created will remain.
cloud.conflictHint: This schedule changed elsewhere. Your edits are still here. Refresh the list and reopen Edit to use the current revision.
cloud.signInHint: Sign in to manage cloud automations. Registered local automations run offline.
cloud.unknownHint: Delivery is uncertain. The schedule is paused and this occurrence will not be sent again automatically. Check the computer and related session before creating new work.
cloud.INVALID_CRON: Enter a valid five-field Cron schedule and IANA time zone.
cloud.CONFLICT: This schedule was changed by another request.
cloud.NOT_FOUND: This schedule is no longer available.
cloud.JOBS_DISABLED: Cloud scheduling is disabled on this server. You can save schedules, but they will not execute until scheduling is enabled.
cloud.JOB_BUSY: An earlier run is still active or has an unknown outcome.
cloud.ALREADY_RUNNING: An earlier run is still active.
cloud.DEVICE_OFFLINE: The computer is offline. No new session was started.
cloud.DEVICE_REVOKED: The computer connection was revoked. Choose a current connection.
cloud.DEVICE_EPOCH_MISMATCH: The computer reconnected. Edit the schedule and select its current connection.
cloud.PROJECT_UNAVAILABLE: The project is no longer authorized on this computer.
cloud.AGENT_UNAVAILABLE: The selected agent is unavailable on this computer.
cloud.PROJECT_BUSY: Another session is using this project.
cloud.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again to manage these schedules.
cloud.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
cloud.NETWORK_UNAVAILABLE: Unable to complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
cloud.INVALID_JOB: The schedule or its action is invalid.
cloud.CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: A selected reference revision is unavailable. Edit the schedule references.
cloud.CONTEXT_ARCHIVED: A selected reference was archived. Edit the schedule references.
cloud.CONTEXT_PROJECT_MISMATCH: A selected reference does not belong to this project.
cloud.CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: The session and selected references exceed the context limit.
cloud.CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE: The reference library is unavailable. Check the run before trying again.
cloud.CONTEXT_REQUEST_EXPIRED: The delivery recovery window has expired. Check the original session status before taking another action; no execution was resent.
cloud.DELIVERY_EXPIRED: Delivery timed out. Check the run before trying again.
cloud.DELIVERY_UNCERTAIN: Delivery is uncertain. No automatic retry will be made.
cloud.JOB_LIMIT: This account has reached its schedule limit.
cloud.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request identifier was already used with different content. Refresh and check the original schedule or run before editing.
cloud.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The selected agent is no longer enabled or installed on this computer.
cloud.UPGRADE_REQUIRED: Update Desktop and the device host to support scheduled synchronization.
cloud.MISSED_SCHEDULE: This occurrence was missed and skipped. The next future occurrence remains scheduled.
cloud.HOST_RESTARTED: Scheduling restarted before synchronization completed. This occurrence was not retried.
cloud.DELIVERY_FAILED: The device could not complete delivery. Check the related session.
cloud.DEVICE_CHANGED: The device authorization changed. Edit the schedule and choose the current connection.
cloud.DEVICE_REPLACED: The computer connection changed. The next occurrence will check it again.
cloud.CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE: The server cannot reach its device relay.
cloud.AGENT_FAILED: The related agent session failed. Open it to inspect the result.
cloud.SERVER_UNAVAILABLE: The server is unavailable. Check the run before trying again.
cloud.REQUEST_CLOSED: Delivery was interrupted. Check the run before creating new work.
cloud.REQUEST_TIMEOUT: The request timed out. Check the previous schedule or run before trying again.
